title: UnitedHealth Stock (UNH) Falls 5.6% as Health Insurers Slide (Nov 19)
summary: UNH fell 5.55% to $330.48 on Nov 19 as health insurers slid on a renewed Medicare for All push and a CMS plan to widen Medicare Advantage audits.
body_markdown:
## Why UnitedHealth Stock Fell


Financial media tied Thursday's decline to a wider selloff in health insurers. As reported by[Barron's](https://finance.yahoo.com/m/94c5daa3-dbb2-3500-8639-d52a402ecc88/unitedhealth-stock-continues.html) , UnitedHealth and other insurer stocks were falling on Thursday as Democrats' sweep of Congress "breathed new life into the push for Medicare for All."


The pressure started with regulators earlier in the week. According to the[Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)](https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/USCMSMEDICAID/bulletins/43304ec) , its CRUSH proposed rule, released on November 16, would strengthen Medicare Advantage risk adjustment data validation audits to identify and recover improper payments, and could save taxpayers nearly $90 billion over 10 years. Per[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/bernstein-500-target-says-unitedhealth-223737665.html) , the plan would extrapolate audit findings to whole contracts and claw back overpayments as far back as 2018, with CMS putting the take at about $9 billion per payment year industry-wide. UnitedHealth has not sized its share.


The selloff deepened on Wednesday, November 18, when[UnitedHealth fell 10.2%](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/unitedhealth-unh-stock-news-november-19-2026/) , according to[Trefis](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/just-happened-unitedhealth-stock-123719226.html) , which noted that the company released no announcement, earnings report or filing and that all seven other managed health care companies worth $2 billion or more fell the same session, with Humana down 13.0%. TIKR also reported that Senator Elizabeth Warren called that day for breaking up UnitedHealth, CVS Health and Cigna, writing that the three "take a cut at every step."


## UNH Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- UnitedHealth reported third-quarter adjusted earnings of $4.69 per share, up from $2.92 a year earlier, according to TIKR.
- The CRUSH rule is still a proposal, and CMS is taking public comments until January 19, 2027, so its final terms are not yet set.
- Trefis noted that management expects 2026 to be the low point for its core Medicaid margins, as the company works with states on rates.


### Risks


- Wider audits with a look-back to payment year 2018 could lead to repayments, and UnitedHealth has not sized its share, per TIKR.
- Oppenheimer expects most recoveries under the plan to land in 2028 to 2030, which TIKR says puts 2028 earnings most at risk.
- Political pressure is building, with Barron's tying the insurer selloff to the Medicare for All push and Senator Warren calling for breakups.
- Medical costs take most of premiums: the medical care ratio was 88.4% in the third quarter, according to Trefis.


Looking ahead, TIKR expects management's 2027 outlook before year-end, and Trefis estimates fourth-quarter 2026 results in January 2027, with no date confirmed.
